# Superpowers

- Upstream: `https://github.com/obra/superpowers`
- Purpose: software-development methodology and engineering workflow.
- Role in D-AI-Hub: process layer for brainstorming, planning, TDD, debugging, review, verification, and branch completion.
- Installation: install through the supported plugin/skills mechanism for each harness; do not vendor the upstream repository here by default.
- Compatibility: supports Codex and multiple coding agents; ChatGPT Web support depends on available plugin/skill capabilities.
- Pinning: track a version or commit only when reproducibility requires it.
- Local modifications: none.
